# One module per case, mn-<case>.yang, each adding a mandatory node to another
# module (mn-base) with an augment, or putting one under a choice's default case
# (or not). scripts/pyang-oracle.sh and scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh record whether
# pyang and yanglint reject each, compiled with mn-base; test/compile/mandatory.test.ts
# checks that @node-net/yang reports the code given here, and agrees with both.
#   case  expected: ok, an error code, or warning:<code>
